lines.text: At the windy lookout, Mia's fingers were so numb she couldn't open her snack bag.
Her gloves were still in her pack, saved for later.
Here's the fix. Put gloves on before your fingers get cold, not after.
Keep your core warm, because when it cools, your body cuts blood flow to your hands first.
Eat a snack, carry a spare pair.
On the next summit, Mia's hands stayed warm.
Save this before your next cold hike.
